from agents import function_tool
from custody_client import CustodyClient
custody = CustodyClient.from_env()

@function_tool
def add_multisig_cosigner(wallet_id: str, cosigner_public_key: str, label: str, new_threshold: int=0) -> dict:
    policy = custody.wallets.get_policy(wallet_id)
    signers = list(policy['signers'])
    signers.append({'public_key': cosigner_public_key, 'label': label})
    threshold = new_threshold or policy['threshold']
    # Pending approval requests were collected under the old signer set;
    # cancel them so they must be resubmitted under the new policy.
    cancelled = []
    for req in custody.wallets.list_approval_requests(wallet_id, status='pending'):
        custody.wallets.cancel_approval_request(wallet_id, req['id'])
        cancelled.append(req['id'])
    updated = custody.wallets.update_policy(wallet_id, signers=signers, threshold=threshold)
    return {'wallet_id': wallet_id, 'signer_count': len(updated['signers']), 'threshold': updated['threshold'], 'added': cosigner_public_key, 'cancelled_requests': cancelled}
